explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/680, second question: is the statement false with k^2+1 replaced by e^{(1+ε)√k}+C_ε, for every ε > 0 and some constant C_ε > 0? The formalisation is ∀ ε > 0, ∃ C > 0, ¬(∀ᶠ n, ∃ k ≠ 0, minFac(n+k) > exp((1+ε)√k)+C). It reads 'can one prove this is false' as asserting falsity, which is the standard reading. Faithful.
